brief.creative_description: My friend is getting married and we will be wearing pink and white, so make this align to that
brief.title: Community Excellence Awards

programme.title: Welcome by the master of ceremonies

direction.positive_prompt: The background should be a subtle floral pattern, with a delicate border around the edges, maintaining a sophisticated and minimalist aesthetic
direction.negative_prompt: Do not include any text, logos, portraits, or readable characters in the design. Avoid clutter and maintain simplicity and elegance throughout.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design aims to highlight the elegance and sophistication of the event while maintaining a clean and professional appearance. The use of soft pink and white colors reflects the theme of the event, while the floral pattern and delicate border add a touch of grace and beauty.

direction.positive_prompt: delicate watercolor wash background in shades of blush pink and creamy white, with scattered abstract floral motifs resembling cherry blossoms and roses, Soft, diffused lighting, dreamlike atmosphere, High-resolution, detailed textures, elegant and feminine
direction.negative_prompt: harsh lines, geometric shapes, dark colors, overly saturated, busy patterns, minimalism, text, logos, portraits, writing, borders
direction.short_design_rationale: The design aims for a soft, romantic aesthetic aligned with a bridal shower theme and the requested pink and white colour palette. Watercolor washes and floral motifs create a delicate and celebratory atmosphere, while the diffused lighting enhances the dreamy quality. The design is visually rich and expressive, but avoids any literal representations of text or logos.

direction.positive_prompt: A soft, romantic composition with delicate pink and white pastel hues, featuring an elegant floral background with scattered rose petals, The design should include a soft gradient that transitions from a deeper pink at the top to a lighter pink and white at the bottom, with subtle gold accents to add a touch of luxury, The atmosphere should evoke a sense of joy and celebration, perfect for a bridal shower, The lighting should be soft and diffused, mimicking natural light filtering through sheer curtains
direction.negative_prompt: Dark colors, harsh lighting, geometric patterns, abstract shapes, bold contrast, grunge textures, or any elements that do not align with a soft, romantic, and elegant aesthetic.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design is inspired by the soft and romantic theme of a bridal shower, with a focus on pink and white hues. The floral background and scattered rose petals create a sense of celebration and joy, while the soft gradient and subtle gold accents add a touch of elegance and luxury. The diffused lighting enhances the romantic atmosphere, making it perfect for the occasion.
